title: Wingbox control mapping, format 1
description: The value a control mapping (.wingbox/controls.yaml) holds: for each control of a team the references it answers, its approval, scope, claim, limits, method and the evidence of a run it requires. The file itself is YAML in a small subset that wingbox_controls.py reads line by line (two spaces per level, a value on the line of its key, one `- item` per line, comments on their own lines); this schema describes the same keys and words for an editor. The ids, titles and references are the team's own: the tool does not hold or read a framework.

name.description: The name of the mapping, in the team's words.

version.description: The version of the mapping, in quotes.

owner.description: The role or person that owns the mapping.

controls.description: The controls, each under the team's own id (letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`).

approver.description: Who approved the mapping of this control. An approved control without it supports no claim.

valid-from.description: The first day the approval is in force, in quotes.

valid-until.description: The last day the approval is in force, in quotes.

risk.description: The reference of the related risk.

method.description: The first three are evaluated from a record; the others need a record the tool does not make.

claim.description: The narrow claim the evidence supports.

limits.description: What the evidence does not show.

references.description: What the control answers in a framework: free text of the team.

scope-paths.description: Globs (`*` crosses folders), folders ending in `/`, or modules. A control has scope-paths, scope-parts or both.

scope-parts.description: Parts of the repository as Wingbox names them (coverage.parts of the record).

requires-verdicts.description: The verdicts of the record that must hold.

requires-tests.description: The groups of the manifest of required tests that must have passed.
